accepted.hypothesis: Injecting 500ms network delay on the front-end service edge will cause the front-end home page to exceed the 15s business oracle timeout, resulting in a failure of the golden journey.
accepted.expected_invariant: front-end home page returns HTTP 200 with non-empty HTML within 15s
accepted.validation_plan: Run baseline, inject delay, observe front-end home page response time and status, then recover and washout.
accepted.recovery_expectation: After removing the delay, front-end should recover to baseline within washout period.
accepted.weakness_surface: front-end has no timeout on downstream calls and is a single replica; delay on its own edge directly impacts all user-facing requests.
